Synopsis:
A strong August U.S. payrolls print keeps the Fed under pressure ahead of two imminent catalysts: Friday's CPI release and a Fed rate decision the following week. Concurrently, the ECB is expected to hike on Thursday. Secondary themes include record diesel prices and a far-right party poised to take power in a German state. China's crude oil imports remaining soft in August adds a global demand-side angle.
